messages:
elaine_sec: Auditor requested a compact control crosswalk + a short live replay linking an RBAC change to logs and KMS state. Need plan and artifacts.
matt_oncall: We can do: git diff for the rolebinding, CI build log (with SHA), k8s audit excerpt, CloudTrail export, and KMS describe/rotation status.
auditor_jon: Staging replay acceptable if you sanitize IDs. A 45-90s video and the exact queries you ran are ideal. Also a simple CSV mapping artifact -> SOC2 / ISO clause.
sai_platform: I'll create a throwaway service account and apply a rolebinding in the staging cluster during the window. Will capture kubectl apply output and controller events.
elaine_sec: Paste the commands/queries you'll include so we can attach them to the mapping doc.
sai_platform: kubectl audit extraction (example):
```bash
jq -c 'select(.objectRef.namespace=="staging") | {t: .stageTimestamp, verb: .verb, user: .user.username, obj: .objectRef}' \
  /var/log/kube-audit/audit.log | grep demo-binding | head -n 40
```
CloudTrail/Splunk sample query to export: 
```splunk
index=aws_cloudtrail (eventName=PutRole* OR eventName=AttachRolePolicy OR eventName=CreateRole) | table _time, userIdentity.arn, eventName, requestParameters
```
sai_platform: KMS commands to include in README: 
```bash
aws kms describe-key --key-id <redacted> --profile staging
aws kms get-key-rotation-status --key-id <redacted> --profile staging
```
evidence-bot: Uploaded artifact: ci-apply-9012.log (redacted).
matt_oncall: Reminder: run infra/scripts/scrub-ids.sh before exports. Replace customer UUIDs, hostnames, and IPs.
elaine_sec: Deliverables: rolebinding-diff.patch, ci-apply-9012.log, k8s-audit-snippet.jsonl, cloudtrail-export.csv, kms-rotation.json, splunk-query.txt, mapping.csv, and a 60s MP4. Target: package by tomorrow 11am PT, rehearse with @auditor_jon at 2pm PT.
auditor_jon: That works. Please ensure mapping.csv uses control IDs (SOC2 CCx.x, ISO A.xx) and a one-line note for each artifact. Thanks.
